scope: Source-path mappings for the outer Plotly build and source-map mappings for MapLibre and its style-spec bundle, supplemented by pinned runtime dependency supersets for Mapbox and StackGL where prebuilt module IDs omit source paths. Inclusion in a dependency superset is not a claim that every candidate contributes runtime bytes. Numeric is specifically excluded by the recorded import-graph check.

components.licence_note: The 2.0.2 npm archive omitted the licence file. The upstream maintainer confirmed MIT in issue 11331; this retained licence is the later explicit upstream clarification, not an archive member.
Google Inc. 2011 source attribution is retained. The upstream author field identifies Mark Miller; the source also credits Mark S. Miller.

excluded_components.disposition: Not compiled into the distributed Plotly bundle; present only in a conservative upstream runtime dependency inventory.
excluded_components.reason: gl-mesh3d imports the two-dimensional closest-point submodule directly. Numeric is required only by the unused general-dimensional submodule exposed by polytope-closest-point/index.js. The two-dimensional path and its helpers do not import Numeric.
